headline: OpenAI hires ex-Army Secretary as AI security warnings mount
body: Security stories dominated. OpenAI hired former US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll for a national security role, the day's largest single push to Catastrophic Risk. The UK's NCSC said an AI-powered ransomware attack on UK critical infrastructure is 'highly likely' by 2028, and Binance said its $6.3 billion theft began with a fake job interview and hijacked internal AI tools. Together Catastrophic Risk rose 0.62. On the other side, Ibero-American countries formed an AI Alliance in Madrid, lifting Global Coordination, and a Brazilian court barred Meta from training AI on news content without permission, easing Power Concentration. Self-Destruction was the biggest mover; Libertarian Utopia fell. Horizon Balance fell to -18.32 from -17.93.
movers_note: Self-Destruction +0.63, led by OpenAI's Driscoll hire (+0.33), the NCSC warning (+0.20) and the Binance theft (+0.16). Libertarian Utopia -0.27, mainly from the Driscoll hire (-0.15). Conquerors +0.25, spread across the Driscoll hire (+0.09) and the NCSC warning (+0.05).
